paper_claim: Comparative studies of AI regulation across jurisdictions exist, for example comparisons of the EU, the US and China (cited with du2025toward).
evidence_summary: The paper compares AI regulation in the EU (risk tiers, GPAI, AI Office; Sec. 4), China (registration and security assessments; Sec. 5) and the US (Executive Order 14110, California SB 1047; Sec. 6) and argues the regimes reflect different outlooks on safety versus innovation.
